This file is inert in the monorepo — GitHub only reads .github/ at a repository root —
and active in the read-only split mirror, which is the point of it.
-->

## This repository is a read-only mirror

`native-symfony/mobile-bundle` is published from the
[nativephp-symfony](https://github.com/sadiqk2/nativephp-symfony) monorepo by subtree
split, and every commit here is generated. **A pull request opened against this
repository cannot be merged** — the next split would overwrite it.

Please reopen it against the monorepo, editing `mobile-bundle/` there:

<https://github.com/sadiqk2/nativephp-symfony/compare>

[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sadiqk2/nativephp-symfony/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
has the development loop, and the pull-request template there is the one to fill in.
